name: hx_moving_boundary_bell
title: Moving-boundary heat exchanger (Bell 2015), evaporator regime
summary: Counter-flow heat exchanger with zones delimited by the phase changes (moving-boundary method of Bell 2015): clamped zone boundaries, per-zone UA and the Bell area constraint A = sum(Q_j/(U_j*LMTD_j)). Five oracle cases of increasing area solved simultaneously; the active zone set (1-3 zones) follows the operating point. Translation of the TESPy MovingBoundaryHeatExchanger.

verification.reference: Bell 2015 oracle tests/test_components/bell2015_five_cases.json (section A, 5 cases), re-generated with the local TESPy clone (commit 19425523) in a throw-away venv: pytest tests/test_components/test_bell2015_oracle.py -> 7 passed
verification.notes: Over Q, T_h_out, T_c_out of the five cases: max |dQ| = 0.0144 % (tolerance 0.1 %), max |dT| = 0.0327 K (tolerance 0.5 K). Case 5 (effectiveness 0.999999) has the largest deviation. CoolProp 'n-Propane' maps to EES 'Propane'; temperatures converted K -> degC by hand, enthalpies untouched.

history.action: added (T-TRANSLATE of TESPy MovingBoundaryHeatExchanger, verified vs the Bell 2015 oracle section A)
